study_identification_part.si4_title: Shared differential factors underlying individual spontaneous neural activity abnormalities in major depressive disorder

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states research hypotheses and describes the purpose of applying normative modeling. The authors hypothesize that individualized ALFF abnormalities can be portrayed as a unique linear combination of shared differential factors. The purpose is explicitly stated: to address heterogeneity among patients with MDD by parsing individualized ALFF abnormalities, identify shared differential factors, explore their neurobiological relevance, and identify distinct depressive subtypes. Both criteria are satisfied: (1) Research hypotheses are provided - the hypothesis that individualized ALFF abnormalities can be expressed as a linear weighted sum of shared differential factors; (2) The purpose of normative modeling is described - to characterize individual-level differential patterns by assessing extreme deviations from normal expectations for disease understanding and identification of subtypes.
